why: Stops failing a page that scrolls sideways. `min-width` on a control in a no-wrap row is how a size floor pushes a 320 px phone layout past the screen edge; issue #686's acceptance criteria name 320x568 and 390x844 as having to stay free of new horizontal overflow, and no per-control size or overlap check can see it.
killedBy: menu hit-target verdict (issue #686) fails a page that scrolls horizontally
